description: Source file implementing the DeviceImplementation class for device identification, including methods to retrieve chipset, firmware version, and serial number, and interfacing with mfrApi.

classes.name: DeviceImplementation
classes.description: Implements device properties and system identifier interfaces, providing methods to retrieve device chipset, firmware version, and serial number.

methods.name: DeviceImplementation

methods.name: UpdateFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Updates firmware version by calling mfrGetSerializedData.

methods.name: UpdateIdentifier
